open_points.subject: A17-1 required test coverage for listener-opening failures
open_points.text:
10. Each check made before the listeners are opened that fails — a
    configuration item, a backup location that cannot be written, an existing
    store failing its integrity check or of another version, a new store that
    cannot be made — stops the start before any listener is opened, and no
    request is served.
open_points.question: Must the Required tests also show that failure to open the service API listener after the owner listener has opened closes the owner listener and serves no request, thereby covering A17-1 for the last checks as well as for checks made before any listener opens?
options: Require a case where the owner listener opens and the service API listener fails, asserting that the first listener is closed and no request is served.
Treat item 10 as covering only pre-listener checks and rely on the normative rule without required test evidence for the second-listener failure history.
open_points.default_guess: Require the second-listener failure case, because A17-1 applies to every check required before serving and the changed item explicitly covers only checks made before listeners are opened.

witness.initial: A complete non-owner-only configuration and a valid existing store; the owner-interface address can be bound, but the service-API address cannot be bound.
events: Registry performs every configuration, location and store check successfully.
Registry attempts to open the service-API listener and that check fails.
outcomes: The required evidence must assert that the owner listener is closed and that no owner request is served.

No Required tests item must exercise this history because item 10 covers only checks made before listeners are opened; an implementation defect in closing or withholding service can pass the stated cases.
witness.observer: The factory check reviewing A17-1 evidence, and an owner whose request reaches the prematurely opened listener if the untested guarantee regresses.
